newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.4 bln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.4 bln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.4 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$800 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$100 million in each of the maturities on offer for its own portfolio.

There was no note tender last week, but the previous week saw the Treasury offer a total of A$1.3 billion of notes, comprising A$600 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$400 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$480 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending October 30.
